verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index and markdown docs are machine-readable documentation, and the official SDKs are typed clients. Both are adjacent features, not a formal API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
